definitions.explanation: The ability to see; the clearness or sharpness of vision.

examples.japanese: {視力|しりょく}が{落|お}ちたので{眼鏡|めがね}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: My eyesight got worse, so I got glasses.

examples.japanese: {視力|しりょく}{検査|けんさ}の{結果|けっか}は{両眼|りょうがん}とも1.0だった。
examples.english: The vision test results were 1.0 for both eyes.

examples.japanese: {暗|くら}い{所|ところ}で{本|ほん}を{読|よ}むと{視力|しりょく}が{悪|わる}くなる。
examples.english: Reading in dark places makes your eyesight worse.

notes:
{視力|しりょく} refers to eyesight or visual acuity. {視|し} means 'seeing' and {力|りょく} means 'power.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {視力|しりょく}が{良|よ}い: to have good eyesight
- {視力|しりょく}が{悪|わる}い: to have poor eyesight
- {視力|しりょく}が{落|お}ちる: eyesight declines
- {視力|しりょく}を{回復|かいふく}する: to recover eyesight
- {視力|しりょく}{検査|けんさ}: vision test
- {視力|しりょく}{矯正|きょうせい}: vision correction

VISION MEASUREMENT (JAPAN):
- In Japan, vision is measured on a decimal scale
- 1.0 = normal vision (20/20 in US)
- 0.1 = very poor vision
- {裸眼|らがん}{視力|しりょく}: uncorrected vision
- {矯正|きょうせい}{視力|しりょく}: corrected vision

RELATED WORDS:
- {近視|きんし}: nearsightedness
- {遠視|えんし}: farsightedness
- {乱視|らんし}: astigmatism
